spans.s: सगति or सगतिक accompanied by a preposition which is called गति; cf सगतिरपि तिङ्
; cf. also सगतिरपि । प्रपचति M.Bh. on P
सागमक possessed of the augment; cf. अनागमकानां सागमका अादेशाः M. Bh. on

; cf also the verse सर्वे सर्वपदादेशा दाक्षीपुत्रस्य पाणिनेः । एकदेशविकारे हि नित्यत्वं नोपपद्यते । quoted in the Mahabha- sya to support the view that aug- ments are not inserted, but a word with an augment replaces a word without that augment; cf. M. Bh. on
